name: The Woeful Rose & The Bitter Crow
source:
"There is peace in contentment, but it never persists unchallenged."

The life of a rural priest in the Maufere Kingdom can be more exciting than one might think. When there isn’t a devil to cast away or a blessing ritual to complete, life almost feels too quiet. Leone [name & gender customizable] has held the position of the High Truthlight in the barony of Soleil for over 30 years. It’s not a perfect life, but it’s not a bad one either. 

Three strange deaths spark the beginning of a desperate investigation with no leads until two strange men arrive with near-miraculous timing.

Yukimura Hisashi and Zahir are an odd pair.

Hisashi is a stern healer who always gets results. Zahir is a friendly Mawbreaker who never backs down from a challenge. They’re both a long way from home, and the stories of their pasts hang heavy on their shoulders. Still, they dive into the mystery of the area without hesitation or demand for a reward, and Leone works alongside them to the best of their abilities, learning more about them along the way. 

Perhaps Soleil can be the place the pair finally decide to settle down in?

Perhaps it will be just another stop on their journey.

[From [url=https://stygianeyedev.itch.io/the-woeful-rose-the-bitter-crow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“满足中有平静，但它永远不会不受挑战地持续存在。”

莫费尔王国乡村牧师的生活可能比人们想象的更令人兴奋。当没有恶魔可以赶走，也没有祝福仪式可以完成时，生活几乎感觉太平静了。Leone [姓名和性别可自定义] 在Soleil男爵领地担任至高真相之光的职位已超过30年。这不是一种完美的生活，但也不算糟糕。

三起奇怪的死亡事件引发了一场绝望的调查，但毫无线索，直到两个陌生男子在近乎奇迹的时机到来。

幸村尚志和查希尔是一对奇怪的组合。

尚志是一位严厉的治疗师，总能取得成果。查希尔是一位友好的破胃者，在挑战面前从不退缩。他们都离家很远，过去的故事都沉重地压在他们的肩上。尽管如此，他们还是毫不犹豫地探索了该地区的神秘面纱，也不要求奖励，而莱昂内则尽最大努力与他们并肩工作，一路上更多地了解他们。

也许太阳城可以成为这对夫妇最终决定定居的地方？

也许这只是他们旅程中的又一站。

[来自[url=https://stygianeyedev.itch.io/the-woeful-rose-the-bitter-crow]Itch.io[/url]]
